blocks.heading: Right Now, and Which Reopen Next Cycle
rows: MCC NEET UG counselling (MBBS, BDS, BSc Nursing seats)
Open
Round 3 results were due 30 September; reporting 1 to 9 October. Stray vacancy round runs 12 to 26 October.
Andhra Pradesh EAPCET BiPC (B.Pharm, Pharm.D, agriculture, biotech)
Spot only
Final phase reporting ran 24 to 26 September, with 516 seats unfilled. Colleges may offer spot admissions, and those seats do not get government fee reimbursement.
Maharashtra B.Pharm (CAP)
Open
Round 1 reporting 28 to 30 September. Later rounds follow on the state CET cell portal.
BSc Nursing in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
Closed
Registration ended 16 September (AP) and 24 September (Telangana). Check the two universities for any later notice.
ICAR UG through CUET
Closed
Final allotment 22 August 2026. Next cycle follows CUET UG 2027.
IISER through IAT
Closed
Round 9 allotment came out on 9 September. IAT 2027 applications are expected around March and April 2027 (tentative).

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Highest ceiling for people who can prove skill, because the work travels across employers and can be done remotely. PayScale lists general data-analyst entry pay near Rs 4.13 lakh a year (576 salaries, July 2026). The entry requirement is a real quantitative floor, not a certificate.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Seats are not the scarce thing here. Andhra Pradesh's BiPC final phase alone filled 10,543 B.Pharm seats and still left 516 unfilled. PayScale puts entry pay for pharmacists near Rs 2.51 lakh (173 salaries), so the college and the skills you add decide the outcome.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: PayScale entry pay: biotechnologist near Rs 4.92 lakh (44 salaries), food technologist near Rs 3.94 lakh (37), microbiologist near Rs 3.09 lakh (81). These are small self-reported samples, so read them as a rough band and not a promise.
